column15: bit 0 = OFF1_CONTROL: 1 = ready to operate, 0 = ramp stop (OFF1); bit 1 = OFF2_CONTROL: 0 = emergency OFF, coast to stop; bit 2 = OFF3_CONTROL: 0 = emergency stop (OFF3 ramp); bit 3 = INHIBIT_OPERATION: 1 = operation enabled (run), 0 = inhibit; bit 4 = RAMP_OUT_ZERO: 0 = force ramp output to zero; bit 5 = RAMP_HOLD: 0 = hold ramp; bit 6 = RAMP_IN_ZERO: 0 = force ramp input to zero; bit 7 = RESET: 0->1 = fault reset; bit 8 = Reserved; bit 9 = Reserved; bit 10 = REMOTE_CMD: 1 = fieldbus control (manual text truncated to 'Fieldbus control d.'); 0 = last CW/reference kept unless both are 0; bit 11 = EXT_CTRL_LOC: 1 = select EXT2, 0 = select EXT1; bit 12 = USER_0; bit 13 = USER_1; bit 14 = USER_2; bit 15 = USER_3
